name: Jonathan T Abrahamsen

bio.statement: The voters' pamphlet List of Candidates shows Jonathan T Abrahamsen, Republican, as a candidate for State Representative, 13th District, marked with an asterisk meaning he chose not to submit a voters' pamphlet statement.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

gaps: He chose not to submit a voters' pamphlet statement (marked '*' on the List of Candidates, Book4 p.26), so no pamphlet bio, positions or endorsements exist.
No campaign website, official office page or news coverage with his own statements was found; news-domain searches returned nothing about him.
No positions or voting record were collected.
